bio: This is the “casa” of famous wine expert Alejandro Vigil, known more widely as “the Messi of Wine”, having been the first to be awarded 100 points by Robert Parker for his Argentinian wines, namely the iconic 2013 Gran Enemigo Single Vineyard Gualtallary and the 2016 Adriana Vineyard River Stone. The restaurant’s setting in Chachingo comes as a something of a surprise, and is inspired by Dante’s Divine Comedy (the story of a journey from hell to paradise, as well as that of the struggle with the inner self, hence his El Enemigo (The Enemy) wine brand).
